description: Header file defining classes and functions for memory-mapped ELF file handling and unwinding in the torch::unwind namespace, including MemFile and Section structures.

classes.name: Section
classes.description: Represents a section of a memory-mapped ELF file, providing access to its data and string retrieval.

classes.name: MemFile
classes.description: Manages memory-mapped ELF file, providing access to its sections and ELF header information.

methods.name: Section.string
methods.description: Returns a C-string from the section data at a given offset.

methods.name: Section.lexer
methods.description: Creates a CheckedLexer for parsing data at a given offset within the section.

methods.name: MemFile.constructor
methods.description: Opens and memory-maps a file, verifying it is a valid ELF file.

methods.name: MemFile.data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the mapped file data.

methods.name: MemFile.valid
methods.description: Checks if the file descriptor is valid.

methods.name: MemFile.size
methods.description: Returns the size of the mapped file.

methods.name: MemFile.getSection
methods.description: Retrieves a section by its section header or name.
